summary: Lookalike web-vitals polyfill ships obfuscated service-worker traffic-redirection payload
details: The package name mimics the widely-used web-vitals polyfill but the tarball ships disk/index.min.js, a base64-wrapped service-worker payload (self.__PWA_ROUTER__.executeTacticalRouting) that resolves an active destination via DoH TXT lookups of api.chinazhangsan.ccwu.cc (queried through doh.pub and dns.alidns.com) with base64-encoded fallback endpoints on gist.githubusercontent.com/chinazhangsan999-crypto and api.npoint.io, performs decoy fetches, and issues Response.redirect(targetUrl, 302) to the resolved host. package.json declares main: index.js which is not present in the tarball, so the package has no legitimate library surface; its shipped code is exclusively the obfuscated redirector, intended to be loaded into a consuming site's service worker where it can hijack end-user navigation to attacker-chosen destinations resolved at runtime through multi-provider DNS-over-HTTPS and paste-site fallbacks.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
